name: Captain Rugelfuss
summary: At Loch Modan’s southern gate, Captain Rugelfuss meets a sudden trogg uprising. The stern dwarf organizes the defense of the border.

sections.title: Holding the Southern Gate
sections.body: From the Valley of Kings, Captain Rugelfuss guards Loch Modan’s southern gateway. Ironforge’s forces are stretched thin across the world, so veteran officers like him defend its home territories. He sets military ceremony aside and turns to the danger at the border.

sections.title: The Trogg Incursion
sections.body: Troggs surge into the highlands from ancient caverns. They have overwhelmed outlying dwarven patrols and built fortified footholds nearby. Rugelfuss calls on capable travelers to thin their ranks and drive them back from the roadway, defending the King’s lands.

sections.title: Frontline Reconnaissance
sections.body: Rugelfuss’s mountaineers keep watch beyond the gate. They continually scout trogg encampments.

faq.answer: At Loch Modan’s southern gateway in the Valley of Kings, Captain Rugelfuss commands Ironforge’s defense. He guards the frontier against the trogg uprising.

faq.q: Where can Captain Rugelfuss be found?
faq.answer: You can find Captain Rugelfuss near the South Gate in the Valley of Kings. He guards the southern pass from Loch Modan toward Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why is Captain Rugelfuss concerned about troggs?
faq.answer: A recent trogg uprising threatens dwarven settlements and supply lines. Troggs have reached the southern gateway and attacked Ironforge patrols, putting the King’s territory at risk.

faq.q: Why does Rugelfuss brush off military formalities?
faq.answer: Rugelfuss sets ceremony aside because he sees it as a distraction while the King’s lands face attack. He wants practical action at the border.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see Ironforge’s resolve in Captain Rugelfuss’s defense of ancestral mountain passes against subterranean foes.
As an Alliance traveler, you know that guarding the homelands from savage incursions matters while armies fight elsewhere.
As a warrior, you may recognize Rugelfuss’s direct approach: clear the front lines with blade and shield.
